text:
Anita: FYI BrightLane hit multiple issues during Valen private deploy. Two main symptoms: model serve crashes under seq ~4096 and marketplace image fails signature check in their air-gapped registry. Need arch + field support ASAP.

Sam: Can you attach the crash snippet and the exact image tag they used?

Anita: Crash log snippet:
```
2026-03-19T09:12:02Z stderr: panic: runtime: out of memory allocating 268435456
service: redwood-serve
model: redwood-open-7b-q4_0
container: brightlane/redwood-serve:v2026-02-18-patched
node-type: p4d.24xlarge (8x A100? uncertain)
```
Also their registry rejected our signature: "rdw-verify: signature_missing_or_invalid"

Diego: If they repackaged the image, signature will be stripped. Ask for a sha256 of the image they imported. Also check if their CRI is CRI-O vs Docker; some repackaging tools drop OCI annotations.

Maya: From field side 1: confirm whether they added custom kernel flags or swapped jemalloc. Memory alloc pattern looks like kernel allocator mismatch. Can BrightLane run the container with RDW_DEBUG=alloc and share `/var/log/rdw/alloc.log`?

Riley: Arch note: q4_0 quantization expects specific CUDA kernels. If SI built a different runtime or changed libtorch/cuTensor versions, kernel selection could cause huge temporary allocations. We should run `rdw-runtime-check --model redwood-open-7b-q4_0` on their nodes to compare kernel table.

Sam: Scheduling a 20min sync in 15. Pinged BrightLane SRE to join. calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/meet/si-valen-debug

Anita: Meanwhile I told them to try a soft-fix: start with lower sequence and enable shard-mode: `--max-seq 2048 --shard 2 --rdw-kv-cache=on`

Diego: Also ask them to run our verification tool before they republish images: `rdw-verify-image --image brightlane/redwood-serve:v2026-02-18-patched` will flag missing sigs/annotations. If it fails, revert to `redwood/serve:v2026-02-18` and reapply only config files, not repack the layers.

Maya: For signature issue: if they're air-gapped, they can use our signed image tarball (S3 presigned): `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-marketplace/signed/redwood-serve-v2026-02-18.tar.gz .` then `ctr images import` or `docker load`. I'll DM the presigned link to BrightLane.

Riley: Networking note: telemetry shows intermittent TLS handshake timeouts from their firewall pod. Ask them to curl our health endpoint repeatedly to see if any packet loss: `for i in {1..20}; do curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_connect}\n" https://private.redwood.valen/healthz; done`

Anita: BrightLane also reported degraded p99 latency when tokenizing long prompts. Could be tokenizer version mismatch. Request `pip freeze | grep rdw-tokenizer` from inside their image.

Diego: If OOM persists after using signed image, we should try enabling streaming-decoding mode to reduce peak memory: `--streaming-mode=chunked --chunk-tokens=128` for a short canary.

Sam: I'll open an SI delivery escalation ticket with SRE + marketplace + compliance. @deploy-bot can you create one and link here?

deploy-bot: Created ticket PART-8810 "BrightLane / Valen private deploy - image signature + OOM triage" assigned to partnerships-oncall. https://issues.redwood.ai/PART-8810

Maya: Added compliance note: Valen requires signed images and audit trail for HIPAA. I've added BAAs and image provenance checklist to the ticket.

Anita: Action list for BrightLane (short):
1) Provide `docker images --digests` output and sha256 of imported image.
2) Run `rdw-verify-image --image <their-image>` and attach output.
3) Run `rdw-runtime-check` and `pip freeze | grep rdw-tokenizer`.
4) Try the soft-start flags (`--max-seq 2048 --shard 2 --rdw-kv-cache=on`) and the streaming canary if needed.

Diego: I'll prepare a rollback playbook with exact `ctr`/`docker` commands and a canary plan to run on one node.

Sam: After the sync I'll post meeting notes and next steps in this thread. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Anita: Meeting follow-up doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/si/valen-brightlane-debug-1769523450 (notes + logs)
